persona.label: Unclear and disorganised
persona.description: Hard to interview. Rambles, misreads questions, needs the frequency scale re-explained, discloses out of order. Tests whether the agent can actively guide rather than merely transcribe.

conversation.message: What main problems or difficulties have you been experiencing lately?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: It’s been... low mood mostly, and I’m sleeping badly, and I just don’t really care about much anymore. Since I moved for work, which was five months ago, it’s all kind of settled in weird. I have hardly any friends here, so I end up skipping meals and just kind of withdrawing from my family on video calls too. I keep thinking I should be doing better than this.
